faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR IVRI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the Senior Research Fellow post at ICAR IVRI is 25 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the institute by this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Senior Research Fellow position in the ICAR Indian Veterinary Research Institute recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ICAR IVRI Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Senior Research Fellow posts at ICAR IVRI is Offline. Candidates need to send their completed application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow post is 35 years for male candidates and 40 years for female candidates. Age relaxation applies as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-graduation degree in Animal Nutrition, biotechnology, Microbiology or allied sciences along with NET, or a Doctoral degree in relevant subjects.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Senior Research Fellow post at ICAR IVRI?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Research Fellow is Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years, increasing to Rs. 42,000 per month during the third year, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ICAR IVRI Senior Research Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Senior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position at ICAR IVRI involves an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Research Fellow position is Izatnagar, Uttar Pradesh, specifically at the ICAR Indian Veterinary Research Institute.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the application form for ICAR IVRI recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form from the official website of ICAR Indian Veterinary Research Institute. Please refer to the official notification for the exact link.
